D/21 Restoration Application (MCC) No.6 of 2025
In
WPSS No.359 of 2022
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Ms. Deepa Arya, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
 Mr. Siddhartha Sah, Advocate for the 
respondent.
 Instant petition was listed on 
07.05.2025, on that date none appears on 
behalf of the petitioner. Therefore, the 
petition was dismissed in non￾prosecution.
 Now, a restoration application has 
been filed on the ground that the counsel 
for the petitioner could not appear on the 
date fixed.
 Having heard, this Court is of the view 
that there is a good ground to allow the 
restoration application. 
 The restoration application is allowed. 
 The order dated 07.05.2025 is recalled. 
The petition is restored to its number.
 List on 06.08.2025. 
 
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 09.06.2025
Sanjay
